info.name: PayOps v2 — Full Test Suite
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for PayOps v2.0.0 environment.
Groups: Infrastructure · Tasks · Reset · Terminal Actions · Wrong Actions · Investigation · State · Grader · Replay · Baseline · Analytics · Leaderboard · Edge Cases · Perfect Episode · Budget Mechanics

Base URL variable: {{base_url}} = http://localhost:8000

item.name: E-05 Partial credit — flag instead of escalate (MED-001)
F-01 inspect → reward=0.15, notes populated, budget=4.9
F-11 file_sar → reward=0.15, docs_notes has SAR, budget-0.05
G-02 State — budget_spent reflects investigation costs
I-02 Replay — with inspect sub-actions → budget_spent=0.1
I-04 Replay — all-wrong actions → score very low
I-07 Replay — does NOT alter live server state

exec: // capture current state to compare after replay
pm.test('server state unchanged after replay', () => pm.expect(before).to.eql(after));
pm.test('returns message or episode data', () => pm.expect(hasMsg || hasData).to.be.true);
// Run a complete episode first so analytics has data
// Note: triggering via test runner means sequence matters — this prerequest
// runs before the actual GET /analytics is sent.
pm.test('no entries yet (ok before completing episode)', () => true);

item.name: L-03 Leaderboard — after baseline run, count >= 1

exec: pm.test('at least one entry after baseline', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().count).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: M-06 Replay — heavy investigation causes budget_penalty
N-04 Replay with partial confidences (shorter than actions)
O-21 Grader — score=1.0 after perfect episode
